items.t: Lithium Junior Miners News For The Month Of November 2026
items.sum: Lithium spot prices fell over the past month, while Benchmark forecasts deficits of 171,000 tonnes in 2026 and 44,000 tonnes in 2027.

items.t: Lithium Americas Corp. (LAC) Upgraded to Strong Buy: Here's What You Should Know
items.sum: Lithium Americas Corp. (LAC) might move higher on growing optimism about its earnings prospects, which is reflected by its upgrade to a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy).

items.t: Lithium Americas: Capex Reset May Be Overlooking The Ownership Upside
items.sum: Analyst sees LAC's Thacker Pass as a $2.7B-$5.5B NPV project at $24,000-$36,000/t lithium, against $3.83B costs; dilution could impair returns.
